notes.title: Hotfix 0.9.0-demo – Bug Fixes for the Demo
notes.content:
[h3]This version [b]0.9.0-demo[/b] had the goal to fix 2 issues:

[b]1 - [/b]A bug allowing you to complete a quest even when you didn't have the required Items.
[b]2 - [/b]High CPU usage.  

Unfortunately, it also introduced a new bug, which happened when you opened the Quest Button in the footer.  

To fix that, I released version [b]0.9.1-demo,[/b] so please make sure that you are not using the [b]0.9.0-demo[/b].  

Sorry for the inconvenience.[/h3]
